title: Devi Stuti (Ya Devi)
author: Durga Saptashati, chapter 5
intro: The hymn of the gods to the Goddess from chapter 5 of the Durga Saptashati (Devi Mahatmya). After five verses of salutation comes the famous ya devi sarva-bhuteshu: twenty-one verses naming the forms in which the Goddess dwells in all beings, each ending namas tasyai namas tasyai namas tasyai namo namah.
note: All verses are in Anushtubh. In the ya devi verses only one word changes each time, so learning the pattern once opens the whole hymn. Verses follow the commonly printed text; printed editions include a few more verses in this section.
